problem: Student-profile report card offered Refresh without a report-owner eligibility check, although the mutation requires ownership.
A failed latest-report lookup displayed the empty-report generation state.
The returned creation date was labelled as a last-update date.
Late refresh completion could navigate or notify after the card switched to another student.
change: Latest-report handler derives a strict is_report_owner hint from authenticated caller and stored owner without returning user_id. Caller-supplied ownership flags are ignored.
Open remains for caller-visible reports; Refresh is rendered and invoked only for confirmed report owners. Mutation/RLS/entitlement checks are unchanged.
Empty-report creation link requires confirmed editing access supplied by the existing student permission check, matched to the selected student ID. Missing access defaults to no creation link.
Load failures have a distinct retry state; empty results do not claim global report absence.

Card state is keyed by student; pending reads/refresh results from the previous card cannot update the new card or trigger stale navigation/toasts. Duplicate refresh clicks are suppressed while pending.
Creation date is labelled Created; no update timestamp is invented.

rolesAndDemo.assessment: Ownership hint and nonowner mutation denials tested across all seven role labels. This is not a grant of the student-profile route to all roles. Existing family/educator/admin route audience policy remains unchanged; no Owner/admin backend data policy is changed.
rolesAndDemo.demo: Fictional demo/fixed-share readers already omit live generation/refresh via their existing demo/read-only guards. No fake ownership, live API calls or demo generation is added.
rolesAndDemo.limits: Mocked handler/component tests do not establish hosted RLS, linked-editor acceptance, all-role feature acceptance or live generation success.
